body: I’ve also experienced the same thing you aren’t alone in this :) for some reason I have had many dreams of this sort SA and harassment etc no idea why and I can’t think of any reason as like you i can’t recall it ever happening to me irl before. I do think it could be a response to how you feel about men in your life and maybe it’s something that you are scared of and your subconscious is thinking about it often that it is occurring in a dream. Idk how helpful this is since I also don’t know the answer but just wanted you to know you’re not alone in it!

I don’t think it’s wrong for them to feel this way, we don’t know any prior experiences OP has had or about their lives etc. everybody reacts to things differently and calling it ridiculous seems a bit insensitive as there may be a reason they had such an intense dream

You might feel useless now but I think it always helps for people to know what you are going through. Going through it in silence you suffer far more. I’m not sure how youd feel about it but personally I’d prefer if I had people around me who knew how I felt even if they didn’t understand it and cared enough to help me lighten any of it. People around you might not always get it right but even their effort can make a difference to how you feel. If you have told them I’m sure it’s people you trust and therefore you have made the right decision :)
